reason: Checked against the source. restore_block's each_part (src/render.6502 2038-2070): the lo ADC (CLC; save_start_lo,Y + rb_part2,X) carries into the hi ADC; start + part offset is an address in the save arena / player_save (&34D5-&3FFF), so the hi ADC never carries out and C = 0 after it. SBC #7 with C = 0 gives A - 8 with the same C (and N, Z, V) as SEC; SBC #8. TYA; SBC #0 gives the same hi as the reload from rb_p8+1. rb_p8 (&47/&48, ren_zp) is written and read only here (grep: render.6502 2050, 2056); ren_zp is documented as read by nothing else (not logic, front end, interrupt, save/restore_game_zp), so dropping the store changes no state anyone reads. Y: columns sets Y (LDY #10) before any use and does not read it on entry; .no_part/part 1 reload Y from rb_index. Stack pushes/pops unchanged. No PROTECT or PROTECT_BYTES entry covers render.6502, not a generated source, not raster-timed; v_ptr reads are through (v_ptr),Y as before, no ROMSEL/ACCCON change, zero-page writes unaffected by ACCCON's X bit. Bank 4 code shrinks 3 bytes (render_end <= REN_BASE still holds; the ASSERTs at 857-862 concern workspace addresses hist0/column_buffer, not code). Cycles: SEC 2 + STA zp 3 + LDA zp 3 = 8 removed, TAY 2 + TYA 2 added: 4 a part. Bytes: 1+2+2 removed, 1+1 added: 3.
